business_problem: LiveRamp leveraged Google Cloud and AI to automate operational center tasks, significantly boosting developer productivity and improving SLA attainment for its global engineering teams.
solution_summary: LiveRamp's key technology goals for the OC automation project were modernization, cloud-enabled scalability, and AI-driven operational efficiency. They aimed to eliminate manual ticket routing, speed resolution, and minimize repetitive support work. Prior IT environments relied heavily on manual ticket handling, and high context-switching overhead, creating engineering bottlenecks. The objectives were to automate ticket assignment using a fine-tuned AI model on historic JIRA data, introduce a Slack bot for automated real-time responses by leveraging team-specific data, and trigger infrastructure workflows directly from JIRA for fast resolution. True operational value lies in delivering a seamless, unified user experience across channels like Slack, web UI, and Jira, enabling users to get support wherever they work.
